title: Grounding Driving VLA via Inverse Kinematics
abstract: arXiv:2605.21061v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Counterfactual obstacle insertion exposes blind planning in representative Driving VLAs: their trajectories remain largely unchanged despite a vehicle appearing directly ahead. An empirically calibrated bias-variance analysis identifies how ego-predictable training examples admit a shortcut through ego status and commands. We address this failure with an inverse-kinematics-inspired architecture that anchors trajectory decoding on current and predicted future visual states. First, a next visual state prediction objective that requires the LLM to predict the future visual scene provides dense visual supervision and suppresses shortcut paths. Second, a separate Inverse Kinematics Network (a cross-attention-based conditional diffusion model) that takes only the current and future visual states as input is designed to suppress reliance on ego status and textual shortcuts during trajectory decoding. translated_title: 通过逆运动学实现驾驶VLA的落地
translated_abstract: 反事实障碍物插入实验揭示了代表性驾驶VLA（视觉-语言-动作）模型中存在的“盲目规划”问题：即使一辆车直接出现在前方，模型生成的轨迹依然基本保持不变。经实证校准的偏差-方差分析表明，自车可预测的训练样本使模型能够借助自车状态和指令形成捷径。为解决这一失效问题，我们提出一种受逆运动学启发的架构，将轨迹解码锚定在当前和预测的未来视觉状态上。首先，引入下一视觉状态预测目标，要求LLM预测未来的视觉场景，从而提供密集的视觉监督并抑制捷径路径。其次，设计了一个独立的逆运动学网络——这是一种基于交叉注意力的条件扩散模型，仅以当前和未来视觉状态作为输入，用于在轨迹解码过程中抑制对自车状态和文本捷径的依赖。我们的0.5B模型实现了最先进的……
tldr: 该论文通过要求LLM预测未来视觉场景并引入仅以视觉状态为输入的逆运动学条件扩散网络来锚定轨迹解码，消除了驾驶VLA对自车状态和指令捷径的依赖，解决了障碍物出现时轨迹不响应的安全隐患。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an inverse-kinematics-inspired Driving VLA architecture that anchors trajectory decoding on current and predicted future visual states—via a next-visual-state prediction objective and a vision-only Inverse Kinematics diffusion network—eliminating reliance on ego-status and command shortcuts.
